defs.def: a title that comes before a woman's family name or before her first and family names together, and that can be used when you do not want to state whether she is married or not （用于女子的姓氏或姓名前，不指明婚否）女士

ex.s: As an award-winning cookbook author, Ms Young, now 66, has spent decades shopping the same way in New York’s Chinatown.
ex.t: 作为一位获奖食谱书作者，现年66岁的杨女士几十年来一直以同样的方式在纽约唐人街购物。

ex.s: Ms Young developed a passion for cooking at an early age.
ex.t: Young 女士早年培养了对烹饪的热情。

ex.s: After college, Ms Young moved to New York and worked in a book-packaging company.
ex.t: 大学毕业后，杨女士搬到纽约，在一家图书包装公司工作。

ex.s: Ms Young has also devoted herself to supporting the restaurants in Chinatown.
ex.t: 毕竟，如果不偶尔犯错，任何事都不可能有进步。

ex.s: Since early 2020, Ms Young has raised money to buy meals from Chinatown restaurants and deliver them to those in need.
ex.t: 自2020年初以来，杨女士一直在筹款购买唐人街餐厅的餐食并送给需要帮助的人。

ex.s: What is Ms Young known as?(no more than 5 words)
ex.t: 杨女士以什么身份闻名？（不超过 5 个词）

ex.s: Why did Ms Young want to record her parents’ recipes?(no more than 15 words)
ex.t: 杨女士为什么想记录她父母的食谱？（不超过15个词）

ex.s: What has Ms Young done to help Chinatown restaurants?
ex.t: 杨女士为帮助唐人街餐馆做了什么？

ex.s: How does Ms Young inspire you in her efforts to preserve Chinese Culinary traditions?
ex.t: 杨小姐如何激励你努力保存中国烹饪传统?.

ex.t: 第二天，当布莱克女士在班上朗读这篇文章时，大家都笑了。

ex.s: Most page turners are piano students or up-and-coming concert pianists, although Ms Raspopova has once asked her husband to help her out on stage.
ex.t: 大多数翻谱员是钢琴学生或崭露头角的音乐会钢琴家，尽管拉斯波波娃女士曾经让她丈夫在台上帮忙。

ex.s: Why is Ms Raspopova’s husband “the worse page turner”?
ex.t: 为什么拉斯波波娃女士的丈夫是"最糟糕的翻谱员"？

ex.s: “The technologist must build up a story with the patient," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: “技师必须和患者一起构建出一个故事，”勒居耶女士说。

ex.s: “The important thing is that the technologist associates what is happening outside the patient's body with what the patient sees in his head," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: "重要的是技术员要将患者身体外发生的情况与患者脑海中看到的内容联系起来，"勒屈耶女士说。

ex.s: The procedure appealed to the staff a lot when it was introduced in January. fc6It spread like wildfire that someone from France was here to train the technologists," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: 这套程序今年一月推出时很受员工欢迎。“有个法国人来这里培训技术员的消息像野火一样传开了，”勒库耶女士说。
